name: We Norwegians
band_note: mean of sweater entry $249 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Merino and cashmere sweaters, base layers, ski jackets and pants for women and men, sweaters around $300–500, sold through its own stores, website and ski and specialty shops.
origin: Founded in 2013 by Tove Grane; Øyvind Lauritzen.

quote.q: Their vision was to showcase modern Norway through fashion—not only through the use of natural, luxurious materials but also through its people and culture.

opview: “Their vision was to showcase modern Norway through fashion—not only through the use of natural, luxurious materials but also through its people and culture.” — We Norwegians (house), About Us, wenorwegians.us

doors.note: US: 2 own doors, Park City UT (675 Main St) and Aspen CO (465 E Hopkins Ave), both on the US contact page and as 'We Norwegians' rows in the locator feed. The global site (wenorwegians.com) lists Voss, Norway and Park City only; it also has a London in-store sign-up page but gives no London address. The US locator holds 37 rows, all US: the 2 own stores and 35 wholesale accounts (mostly ski and golf shops) in return_stockists.csv.
